Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent pixel-art spell animation sprite sheet for a fantasy RPG, exactly FOUR columns and SEVEN equally spaced rows. 28 isolated sprites with wide transparent gutters. Each row is a coherent four-frame spell animation: charging, release, peak impact, dissipating. Row1 novice arcane mage: small violet-white magic projectile and a focused rune-star impact, no fire. Row2 elemental wizard: orange fire spiral joining a pale ice crescent and a sharp yellow branching lightning bolt into elemental storm. Row3 dark mage: ominous indigo crescent curse sigil, violet spectral chains tightening and a purple soul wisp returning, no green poison, no characters. Row4 archmage: three distinct orbiting fire-orange ice-cyan lightning-gold elemental cores joining a brilliant meteor explosion, clear three-color triangular pattern. Row5 frost sorcerer: sharp pale-cyan glacier spikes growing from a snowflake rune, frozen shell, crystalline shatter and falling ice shards, NO orange. Row6 warlock: deep purple ritual eye with jagged black thorn chains and magenta spreading curse marks, expanding dark-red violet curse detonation, no green poison. Row7 blood mage: rich crimson faceted blood gems orbit a red ritual heart, a clean pointed blood spear and scarlet inward vortex, no gore or anatomy. Side-view/isometric game combat spell effects only, no humans or creatures. Premium crisp chunky pixel clusters, dark outlines, readable silhouettes, limited saturated palettes. Entire sprite inside each cell, no overlap, no labels, no text, no borders, no background, genuine transparent alpha.
